description: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. traces its operations to 1966, when Norwegian commenced operations from Miami, Florida, launching the modern cruise industry by offering weekly departures from Miami to destinations in the Caribbean. NCLH, a Bermuda limited company, was formed in February 2011, and in January 2013 it completed its initial public offering and the ordinary shares of NCLC were exchanged for the ordinary shares of NCLH, with NCLH becoming the owner of 100 percent of the ordinary shares and parent company of NCLC, and in November 2014 it completed the acquisition of PCI. In late 2023, in response to the OECD's BEPS 2.0 Pillar 2 global tax reform, the Company restructured its organizational structure by realigning many of its operations across its three different brands into a single jurisdiction, Bermuda, and its fleet includes ships such as Norwegian Bliss, Joy, Escape, Getaway, Viva, Prima and Encore.
